name: Sonarr
description: Finds, downloads and organizes your TV shows automatically

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Sonarr's database, settings, API key and logs. Back it up.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your MOS storage at the same path, so Sonarr sees your downloads folder and your library (like /mnt/cache/media/TV) and can move files without copying.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Sonarr web app and API, published on host as 6827

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
